newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-BROLIN SEEKS TO TRAIN WITH PARMA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BROLIN SEEKS TO TRAIN WITH PARMA.

text.p: Sweden international Tomas Brolin has asked his former Italian club Parma For permission to train with them, the club said on Friday.
"He asked our permission and, of course, we answered 'yes' but only if Leeds authorise him," club spokesman Giorgio Bottaro said.
"He was in Parma for two days this week and today he moved to Sweden without training with us for the moment," Bottaro added.
Brolin left Parma in November 1995 for English premier league club Leeds but feuded with then-manager Howard Wilkinson and has not been able to agree terms with new boss George Graham.
